issues.where: lower-right ring shadow and the streak that crosses it (crop E in pair-02-b.png)
issues.what: The shadow edge is softer, the faint ring grooves read less distinctly against the darker fill, and the small warm flare accent is weaker.
issues.fix: Tighten the cast-shadow edge slightly, lift just enough shadow detail to recover the curved ring lines, and restore the faint warm accent without brightening the whole shadow.

issues.where: sunlit rings from the left arc through the foreground and right exit (crops B, D, F, G, H and I in pair-02-b.png)
issues.what: Some of the fine stripes and outer/gap edges drift slightly from the target, and the broad beige foreground band looks smoother and pinker.
issues.fix: Keep the overall ellipse and framing, but tune the stripe and gap positions locally, recover the fine striation contrast and take a little pink out of the broad band.

issues.where: sky around the moon, above the planet and behind the right rings (crops B, C and H in pair-02-b.png)
issues.what: Point stars are more conspicuous and the sky has a slightly busier speckled texture; the moon itself remains well matched.
issues.fix: Dial back the brightness and prominence of the small stars and keep the diffuse blue-black sky structure.

issues.where: dark right hemisphere and blue limb (crops A, C and E in pair-02-b.png)
issues.what: The shadow-side limb and its internal bands separate a little less cleanly from the surrounding blacks.
issues.fix: Recover a trace of cool rim separation and low-contrast banding on the night side while preserving the deep blacks.

issues.where: upper limb, lit cloud bands and terminator (crops A, C and H in pair-04-b.png)
issues.what: The warm halo is slightly less diffuse, while the upper blue-gray and gold bands are a little less clearly separated and the cloud texture near the terminator reads coarser.
issues.fix: Give the warm glow a slightly broader falloff and recover the thin, softly separated bands without sharpening the terminator.

issues.where: left sky over the receding rings (crop B in pair-04-b.png)
issues.what: The point stars are brighter and more prominent, drawing attention away from the much fainter arcs at the ring horizon.
issues.fix: Reduce the bright star points and preserve the subtle ring traces against the dark sky.

issues.where: left ring sweep and foreground stripes (crops D, E, F, G and I in pair-04-b.png)
issues.what: A few narrow bands slip in position or contrast, and the bright foreground has slightly less line definition against the grain.
issues.fix: Match the local placement and tonal accents of the fine bands and separate their detail from the grain without altering the matched sweep.
